description: The image behind hint M80C, the 1880 census page for Patrick's household. It reads FLYNN, not the index's Glynn, so the index-vs-tree disagreement resolves in the tree's favour. Keyed on `ark` (search-hints passes the record's imageArk as `ark`, not `imageId`), so image-transcribe-any, keyed on imageId, never shadows it (issue #2029).
